name: Acoustic singer and guitarist for a private party: Mary Jane's Last Dance
seoTitle: Acoustic singer-guitarist: Mary Jane's Last Dance
description: One musician sings and plays Mary Jane's Last Dance, the Tom Petty song, at a private party. You can book a singer and guitarist for just an hour.
more: There's more Tom Petty on the song list, like Free Fallin', along with Ain't No Sunshine, Brown Eyed Girl and Landslide. A singer and guitarist is a lovely fit for welcome drinks, a dinner party at home or a small wedding, and for a milestone birthday we can lean into the songs of one particular decade.
